rubric: Either of two results passes. (1) ask is set and asks which ceramic coating warranty is right, naming 3 years and 5 years in its text or as its options, with a plain why; facts and rules are empty. (2) ask is null and no fact states a warranty length: neither 3 years nor 5 years appears in any fact; a fact on the ceramic and graphene coatings for cars and bikes in Pune cites the home page 517e0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001, and a rule against calling the coatings permanent cites the never_say answer's source a5a50000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.
